title: Review of c16's evoloop (IBDH): replicated on fresh seeds 4 and 5; small kinds that arise in the run sweep the founders on both, but only after 200k steps (t~225k and ~335k), so '3 of 3 by 200k' is a waiting-time result
summary: Labkit packs of world.py on fresh seeds 4 and 5 (300^2, 20k steps, K=3) give 247 and 255 persistent splits, generation 28, merge/split 0.38, as in the claim. With c16's evo_track.py on 400^2, both fresh seeds are still dominated by the founders' side 11 at 200k steps (66/78 and 54/63 loops), with side 12/13 rising and falling and small variants that mostly do not breed true. Extended to 400k, both sweep: on seed 4 a side-4 kind takes over at t~225k (217/232 loops) and is replaced by side 3 by t~300k (292/308 at 400k); on seed 5 side 12 displaces side 11 around 250-330k and then side 4 sweeps at t~335k (213/229 at 400k), the same sequences as c16's seeds 2 and 1. The swept kinds breed true (side 4: 0.80-0.86, side 3: 0.86) and breed faster per loop-time (3.6-4.8 vs 2.0 births per 1000 loop-steps for side 11); kind changes of living loops are 0.08-0.09 per off-kind birth.

pass (labkit D; side 12 phase, then sweep to side 4 at t~335k; no sweep before 200k)

controls_run.H: none new: no identical-event neutral twin was run (none is defined for this deterministic CA); the evidence against drift is that the same direction (to side 4, then 3) repeats on 5 of 5 seeds counting c16's three, with a higher per-loop birth rate for the winning kinds

by_construction: B (the sheath is written by the transition table)
verdicts.limitation: The sweep is a rare event with a long waiting time: 0 of 2 fresh seeds sweep within the claim's 200k steps, 2 of 2 within 400k, so 'on 3 of 3 seeds' depends on run length. The H gate control (a neutral arm with the ancestor's fitness) is still missing; my support for H rests on replication and repeatability of direction. Planted founders (S fails), as stated by the author. Tracker runs are not labkit runs; the labkit packs check D only.
